channel.title: Comments on: Today is Spam Filter Free Day
channel.description: Instant Usability & Web Standards — static archive

item.title: By: louie jerome
item.dc:creator: louie jerome
item.description: It’s amazing how many spam emails are waiting at the gates for you to open them when you have spam filter free day. 1111 spams to delete in 2 hours is huge! I don’t use a spam filter on any of my sites but maybe I should.

item.title: By: Ryan v.
item.dc:creator: Ryan v.
item.description: Hah nothing worse then signing in wordpress only to have 1000 spam comments waiting to be approved.

item.title: By: Jual Rumah
item.dc:creator: Jual Rumah
item.description: I know that filtering 3000 comments a day is really exhausting work but I think using Akismet for judging most all the comment as a spam is really no good. Since, not all comment are spam. maybe you should find some crews to filter comment manually for saving your time.

item.title: By: Acai Berry
item.dc:creator: Acai Berry
item.description:
There is way too much spam on blogs nowdays. Its very hard to determine which is spam and which is relevant to the post. Most blog spam is merely keywords in a weird non humanism fashion. Some can be harder to spot.

Either way, an interesting test.
